Enrich person.name: Susan Smith
Enrich person.title: Chief Operating Officer
Enrich person.summary:
Susan Smith is the Chief Operating Officer at Centene, a leading healthcare enterprise committed to helping people live healthier lives.  In her role, Smith oversees key aspects of business operations, population health, the enterprise transformation office, provider experience and quality.

With nearly two decades of experience in the payer space, Smith's professional journey includes a 19-year tenure at Humana.  She most recently served as Senior Vice President (SVP) of Clinical, Quality and Enterprise Solutions President, where she had oversight of quality; clinical strategy, analytics and product development; clinical operations; risk adjustment; and experience transformation.  Smith also served as SVP of Clinical Solutions and SVP of Medicare and played a pivotal role in designing and developing Medicaid operations and building sustainable organizations and processes during transformative periods.  She started her career at Colgate-Palmolive.

Smith holds a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering and a Master of Engineering in Chemical Engineering from University of Louisville Speed Scientific School.

experience.title: Senior Vice President
experience.summary: In partnership with the People Team, Executive, Business Unit, Market and Product Leaders, and Corporate Communications, we are crafting best-in-class enablement of Centene's enterprise values and cultural attributes, as well as ensuring that our culture is aligned with the company's vision, mission, values, and strategic priorities.  This includes enablement of an inclusive, customer-centric, team-based culture that accelerates performance of our strategic initiatives and drives the recruitment, retention and development of top talent, while remaining anchored in our mission.

experience.title: SVP, Clinical, Quality, and Enterprise Solutions President
experience.summary:
- Newly created enterprise leadership role responsible for clinical and quality analytics, strategy and operations, Stars, risk adjustment, clinical trend management, and enterprise experience transformation
- Consolidated teams (approx. 4500 associates) from 4 different Management Team members 
streamlining the operating model and identifying approximately 8% in administrative cost 
efficiencies.
- Priorities included creating a culture of collaboration and transparency, establishing ways of working, defining success measures, identification of integration opportunities, and prioritizing clinical portfolio to create appropriate balance between optimization of existing programs and development of new interventions.

experience.title: SVP, Clinical Solutions
experience.summary:
- Responsible for the Enterprise Clinical Operating Model including clinical analytics, strategy, 
product, and operations.
- Leveraged analytics, automation, strategic prioritization, and organizational design to identify and realize administrative cost efficiency gains of 10% within first 6 months.
- Team transformed utilization management processes, partnerships and technology to create value 
through administrative efficiencies, outcome optimization and improved experiences for providers 
and members. 
- Implemented agile ways of working within cross-functional product team focused on the post-discharge experience

experience.title: SVP, Medicare
experience.summary:
- Responsible for national level individual Medicare Advantage growth strategy including competitive positioning of product, consumer focused experience design, distribution strategy, operationalizing member benefits and clinical trend management.
- P&L responsibility leader for 3 national level Prescription Drug Plans focused on maximizing enterprise value through leveraging owned pharmacy assets and as a growth driver for Medicare Advantage.
- Led all executive level Medicare business and strategy updates to Management Team and Board of Directors.
- Leveraged as key enterprise leader for executive level initiatives based on cross-functional experience and ability to build trust-based relationships across all levels of the organization.
- Led COVID-19 response team for 2020 member benefit enhancements and 2021 benefit design resulting in improved customer satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: SVP, Healthcare Quality Reporting and Improvement
experience.summary:
- Integrated Stars and Provider Engagement teams with Risk Adjustment to create a unified organization focused on quality outcomes for Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial membership.
- Created enterprise level focus, operating model and strategy for Stars resulting in industry leading 
results within 2 years and have sustained leading position for 5 years.
- Cultivated relationship with industry’s largest electronic medical record vendor and co-created the first payer platform.
- Promoted from Vice President to Senior Vice President January 2018.

experience.title: Vice President, Risk Adjustment
experience.summary:
- Expanded scope of responsibility to include end to end risk adjustment functions – analytics, 
finance, quality, education, retrospective and prospective programs, strategy and audit – for 
Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial lines of business.
- Analytics team created industry leading predictive models creating the foundation for recognition as 
the industry leader in Medicare Risk Adjustment.
